Basic Information

  • Full Programme Name: Adelaide University Research Scholarships (AURS) & Research Training Program Scholarships (RTPS)
  • Host Institution: Adelaide University Australia
  • Location: Adelaide South Australia
  • Positions: 200+ scholarships
  • Study Level: PhD and MPhil (research degrees)
  • Duration: Up to 4 years (PhD) or 2 years (MPhil)
  • Intake: 2027 academic year
  • Funding Type: Fully Funded
  • Stipend: AUD $36,500/year
  • Relocation Allowance: AUD $2,000
  • Application Deadline (Round 1): 30 September 2026
  • Eligibility: Open to domestic and international students

About the Scholarships

Adelaide University Research Scholarships (AURS) and Research Training Program Scholarships (RTPS) are available in every discipline area for outstanding candidates pursuing PhD or MPhil degrees. Adelaide University belongs to the Group of Eight (Go8) Australia's leading research-intensive universities.

Application Rounds for 2027

  • Round 1: Early October 2026 - early November 2026 (Deadline 30 September 2026)
  • Round 2: Mid-February 2027 - late March 2027
  • Round 3: Mid-July 2027 - mid-August 2027

Eligibility Requirements

  • Eligible to enrol in full-time MPhil or PhD programme
  • Open to both domestic and international applicants
  • Excellent academic record and research potential
  • English Language IELTS 6.5 overall (no band less than 6.0) or equivalent
  • Required documents academic transcripts grading scheme English proficiency evidence supervisor confirmation structured CV research proposal

Funding Details

  • Stipend: AUD $36,500/year (living allowance)
  • Tuition: 100% tuition fee waiver for duration of candidature (up to 4 years PhD 2 years MPhil)
  • Relocation: AUD $2,000
  • Health Insurance: Covered for international students (OSHC)
  • Research Support: Additional funds available

How to Apply

  1. Identify potential supervisor and obtain confirmation of supervision
  2. Complete interview with proposed supervisor
  3. Submit application via Adelaide University online portal
  4. Required documents academic transcripts grading scheme English proficiency supervisor confirmation structured CV research proposal
  5.
